newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Social Democrat says Swedish PM negative to EMU.
newsitem.headline: Social Democrat says Swedish PM negative to EMU.

text.p: A Social Democratic parliament member says Sweden's Prime Minister Goran Persson is negative to membership of Europe's economic and monetary union (EMU), television station TV4 reported on Thursday.
"Yes, I'm convinced he (Persson) is (negative to EMU)," Social Democrat Bengt-Ola Ryttar said on the morning news.
But Ryttar, who is against a Swedish EMU link, said Finance Minister Erik Asbrink had a more positive view on EMU.
"By virtue of his office, he (Asbrink) is more positive," Ryttar told TV4.
Persson heads a minority Social Democratic government and Asbrink is expected to announce the party's view on EMU membership in May or June.
